title: 3 Signs It’s Anxiety, Not God
hook: Is it God’s voice or fear’s voice?
script: Is it God’s voice or fear’s voice? If it sounds like a countdown clock, it’s likely anxiety. God leads; He doesn’t rush. If it calls you names and says you’re beyond help, that’s not Him. He convicts but never condemns. If it’s confusing and contradicts Scripture, it’s not His Shepherd voice. God’s voice is gentle, aligns with His Word, and produces peace even when it’s hard. Remember: God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and a sound mind. When the noise rises, slow down, breathe, open Scripture, and ask the Prince of Peace to speak. Save this for the next spiral.

title: The 3-Question Filter for God’s Voice
hook: If you’re feeling anxious, watch this: a 3-question filter to tell if it’s God or fear.
script: If you’re feeling anxious, watch this: a 3-question filter to tell if it’s God or fear. One, does this line up with Scripture and the character of Jesus? God won’t guide you to sin or self-hatred. Two, what fruit does this voice produce? The Spirit brings peace, purity, mercy, and hope; anxiety breeds panic and shame. Three, am I being led or shoved? God’s guidance gives room to wait and trust. Pray, Lord, align my thoughts with Your Word. Write one-sentence answers, read Galatians 5 and James 3, then share with a wise friend. Clarity grows in light.

title: A 7-Day Experiment to Hear God Over Anxiety
hook: If God feels silent right now, try this 7-day listening experiment.
script: If God feels silent right now, try this 7-day listening experiment. Each day, sit for fifteen minutes: read a short passage like Psalm 23, John 10, or Philippians 4, then get quiet and ask, Jesus, what do You want me to know today? Journal four lines: I’m anxious about…, I sense You inviting me to…, the Scripture I’m anchoring to is…, and my one small obedient step is…. End with, Your will, not mine. Watch for gentle peace, repeated themes, and alignment with Scripture. In seven days, notice what changed in you, not just around you.
